items.rationale: No second production kernel is introduced.
No kernel I/O contract changes.
F-TB04 parameter/state/forcing/config/result separation remains unchanged.
No persistent state layout is changed by this adoption.
Worker scratch ownership is tested, not modified.
No production memory-layout change; MultiSWAP execution remains under existing runtime contracts.
Transactional checkpoint/trial/rollback/commit cases are replayed unchanged.
Retry and committed-origin semantics are unchanged.
No day/month/year assumption is introduced.
No coupling-window policy is changed.
Coupling functionality is untouched.
Groundwater interface contract is untouched.
Inherited hard mass gates are replayed without relaxation.
Interface sensitivity contracts are untouched.
No coupling run-count policy is changed.
Permanent MultiSWAP cases are replayed against the later canonical authority.
No MODFLOW-cell cardinality assumption is introduced.
Deep-vadose remains outside SWAP.
No inter-component storage transfer is changed.
No soil-water solver is added or hard-coded.
No physics is duplicated; existing production and immutable oracles are reused.
No HeadCalc-internal dependency is added.
Physics and numerical qualification policy remain separate.
No bounded-cost or fallback production policy is changed.
Reference mode and its authorities remain unchanged.
Existing transaction/restart/worker/mass diagnostics remain qualification observables.
Optional-state scaling case is replayed, while new soil-temperature persistence remains explicitly unclaimed.
Runtime/coupler system composition ownership is untouched.
The adoption uses explicit immutable commit/tree authorities and introduces no hidden runtime dependency.
The workunit has explicit authority, scope, nonclaims, invariant audit and exact-head qualification gate.
